reuse.why: The linker reuses ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and the shared finishLinkingAccount rather than repeating the create/upgrade/sync body, but the downloader does not share anything with its siblings.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is another copy of the token/post/error/response-mapping body already repeated for Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking in sync.ts.

placement.why: Each piece goes where the tree keeps it: linker and handler in accounts/app.ts, downloader and dispatch in sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Only Fintegra wiring is added; nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: The link path is short and uses the shared finisher; the copied downloader follows the existing per-provider pattern, which is consistent but adds one more copy to keep in step.

disguised_duplication.where: The downloader copy in sync.ts is an open, recognisable copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, not disguised.
